generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Entity TransformationDelay
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Defines the properties of the delay for the transformation

fields.title: Block Assist Chance
fields.description: Chance that the entity will look for nearby blocks that can speed up the transformation. Value must be between 0.0 and 1.0

fields.title: Block Chance
fields.description: Chance that, once a block is found, will help speed up the transformation

fields.title: Block Max
fields.description: Maximum number of blocks the entity will look for to aid in the transformation. If not defined or set to 0, it will be set to the block radius

fields.title: Block Radius
fields.description: Distance in Blocks that the entity will search for blocks that can help the transformation

fields.title: Block Types
fields.description: List of blocks that can help the transformation of this entity

fields.title: Range Max
fields.description: Time in seconds to be added to value to have the maximum random time range value until the entity transforms (if non-zero then the time in seconds before the entity transforms will be random between value+range_min and value+range_max)

fields.title: Range Min
fields.description: Time in seconds to be added to value to have the minimum random time range value until the entity transforms (if non-zero then the time in seconds before the entity transforms will be random between value+range_min and value+range_max)

fields.title: Value
fields.description: Time in seconds before the entity transforms
